subject: English
passage: Architect Julia Morgan's 1904 graduation from École des Beaux-Arts marked a breakthrough in her profession. It was there that Morgan completed her final thesis—a design that was celebrated for combining classical French techniques with innovative structural engineering—and ______ lasting mentorships with prominent European architects.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The missing verb is part of the same clause as the verb "completed," and "Morgan" is the subject of both. So we need the past-tense form "established" in order to match "completed."
